notes.title: Gamepad support!
notes.content: Added support for the Xbox 360 gamepad, DualShock 4 also works well, but the Xbox ONE gamepad may not work correctly.

notes.title: Plastic bag and ball gag
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34882436/07228985399b14f6c945a51343033f101f1d4b80.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34882436/0e1663650efa5f1d017da2fe81689a418db99992.jpg[/img][/url] [url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34882436/661e6bfb9e2e9194100f3e77d20c3c2b489780fa.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34882436/ef76de0080be866ef970e6a49c88edeb3c4319f2.jpg[/img][/url] [url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34882436/8f78acab3810e8136481ded856acd884f5a1b1c7.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34882436/4ece5f25ac84fcf1ce70bf08953f6d2ece2cc07f.jpg[/img][/url]
[list]
[*] Implemented a crazy idea that I really liked. Now, if you wish, the
main heroine may have a plastic bag on his head and you need to get to the phone before the heroine suffocates.
[*] Added a ball gag.
[*] Stronger heroine. Moving around is now a little easier.
[*] Added first-person view. It's almost impossible to play, but it was interesting for me to do it :)
[/list]
